# The same discovery with 308 (TECHNIK 4.1.7: in case iOS does not follow
# a 301 with PROPFIND).
@redirect 308

> PROPFIND /.well-known/caldav
> Auth: none
> Depth: 0
< status 308
< header Location /caldav/

> PROPFIND /.well-known/caldav
> Auth: alex
> Follow: yes
> Depth: 0
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:prop><A:current-user-principal/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< value /caldav/ d:current-user-principal <d:href>/caldav/alex/</d:href>

> PROPFIND /.well-known/carddav
> Auth: alex
> Follow: yes
> Depth: 0
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:prop><A:current-user-principal/></A:prop></A:propfind>
< status 207
< value /carddav/ d:current-user-principal <d:href>/carddav/alex/</d:href>
